name: shrike
description: Runtime action governance for Claude Code, from Shrike Security.

plugins.name: shrike-security
plugins.description: Scans commands, file writes, notebook edits, web searches and fetches before they execute and routes on the verdict: allow, warn, require approval, or block. Records what Claude Code's own permission layer decided beside Shrike's verdict. Bundles the governed-tool-use skill and the shrike-mcp security tools.
